stories.title: Anthropic shares jump 17% in Nasdaq debut, valuing AI firm near $2 trillion
stories.line: Anthropic's IPO on Nasdaq valued the Claude maker near $2 trillion, a key test of whether investors still believe in AI spending.

stories.title: Army to detonate degrading lead azide in Iowa Friday, sending possible lead plume toward nearby towns
stories.line: The Army will detonate 68 barrels of degrading lead azide in Iowa Friday, with a possible lead-particle plume reaching nearby towns.

stories.title: U.S. loses measles elimination status after 26 years as transmission persists
stories.line: The U.S. has lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, as the outbreak has spread continuously for over a year.

stories.title: Hackers leak customer data via vendor breach at Chase, Visa and Mastercard
stories.line: Hackers breached a third-party vendor and leaked customer data tied to JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard.

stories.title: Nashville musician Ketch Secor urges country artists to speak out on guns
stories.line: A country musician is urging peers to break their silence on assault rifles and the gun debate after the Nashville school shooting.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin pledge more oil output; Iran and Ukraine left out
stories.line: Trump, Xi and Putin met at an APEC-linked summit and pledged to boost oil production, with Iran and Ukraine left out of the declaration.

stories.title: Trump's CISA nominee won't call Jan. 6 an attack or name 2020 winner at hearing
stories.line: Trump's nominee to lead CISA, the federal cybersecurity agency, declined at a Senate hearing to call January 6 an attack or name the 2020 election winner.

stories.title: European leaders seek talks with Russia on ending the Ukraine war
stories.line: Trump and European leaders are pressing for a Ukraine ceasefire as Europe prepares its own talks with Russia.

stories.title: Senate Republicans block second bid to limit Trump's Iran war powers
stories.line: Senate Republicans blocked a second war powers resolution that would have limited Trump's military action against Iran.

stories.title: Auditors question billions ICE is spending to expand immigration detention
stories.line: ICE is expanding immigration detention with billions in spending that auditors have flagged as a concern.
